title.zh: 認知科學與自由能原理：預測編碼、主動推論與變革的生物學 (CEO/CHRO 視角)
title.en: Cognitive Science & The Free Energy Principle: Predictive Coding & The Biology of Change (CEO/CHRO)

slide_title.zh: 變革抗拒的誤診與預測機器的覺醒 (SCQA & The Cognitive Mandate)

zh: 情境 (Situation)：企業強勢導入 GenAI 系統與激進的組織重組。為確保落地，高管頻繁舉辦激勵大會，並將變革與 KPI 強制掛鉤
衝突 (Complication)：變革遭遇毀滅性的底層抵制。傳統 HR 將其誤診為「員工懶惰、缺乏忠誠」。但神經科學指出，人類大腦是一台「預測機器」，變革帶來了巨大的「預測誤差 (Surprise)」。大腦將這種不可預測性視為「死亡威脅」，從而觸發不可逆的生物性防禦與癱瘓
戰略訴求 (The Ask)：提議徹底燒毀「道德綁架與激勵口號」的舊 HR 手冊。懇請授權導入當代神經科學的終極理論「自由能原理 (Free Energy Principle)」，透過精準控制「預測誤差」，從生物學底層重寫企業的變革方程式
en: Situation: The enterprise aggressively mandates GenAI deployment and radical restructuring. To ensure adoption, the C-Suite hosts relentless motivational rallies and ties the change to punitive KPIs.

Complication: The transformation faces catastrophic frontline sabotage. Legacy HR misdiagnoses this as 'laziness or disloyalty.' Neuroscience reveals the human brain is a 'Prediction Machine.' Radical change induces massive 'Prediction Error (Surprise).' The brain interprets unpredictability as a literal 'death threat,' triggering irreversible biological panic and paralysis.

The Ask: Proposing the absolute incineration of legacy HR manuals relying on 'moral guilt and motivational slogans.' Requesting the mandate to deploy neuroscience's ultimate unified theory: 'The Free Energy Principle.' We will engineer transformation from the biological baseline by surgically managing 'Prediction Errors.'

speaker_notes.zh: 各位董事，當我們推動 AI 變革失敗時，我們總是在罵員工『不思進取』。這是一個極度傲慢且無知的誤診！大腦科學家卡爾·弗里斯頓告訴我們：大腦不是用來思考的，大腦是用來『預測』的。生命存在的唯一目標，就是避免『驚喜 (Surprise/無法預測的事物)』。當你昨天突然宣布公司要全面導入 AI，你打破了員工大腦裡的預測模型。在生物學上，無法預測等於被掠食者吃掉（死亡）。員工的抗拒不是因為懶，而是大腦為了求生而觸發的劇烈防禦機制。今天的提案，是要把 HR 升級為『認知科學家』。我們不再強迫員工改變行為，我們去設計和緩的『預測誤差』，讓大腦自己願意更新模型。
speaker_notes.en: Members of the Board, when our AI transformations fail, we lazily blame the workforce for 'resisting change.' This is an arrogant, unscientific misdiagnosis! Neuroscientist Karl Friston proved that the brain isn't designed for rational thought; it is a 'Prediction Machine.' The singular goal of all biological life is to avoid 'Surprise' (unpredictability). When you suddenly announce a massive AI restructuring, you shatter their brain's predictive models. Biologically, unpredictability equals being eaten by a predator (Death). Their resistance isn't laziness; it is a violent, hard-wired biological defense mechanism. Today's mandate elevates HR into 'Cognitive Scientists.' We stop forcing behavioral change. We surgically engineer manageable 'prediction errors' so the brain organically updates its own models.

slide_title.zh: 主動推論：暗中破壞變革的生物本能 (Active Inference & Org Sabotage)
slide_title.en: Active Inference: The Biological Drive to Sabotage Change

zh: 降低自由能的兩條路 (Minimizing Free Energy)：當現實與大腦預測不符（產生自由能/誤差）時，大腦只有兩種方法消除它：一是「更新內部模型（學習新技能，極耗能）」；二是「改變現實，使其符合舊模型（主動推論）」
主動推論與系統破壞 (Active Inference as Sabotage)：要求資深員工適應全新的 AI 系統（更新內部模型）極度痛苦。因此，大腦會選擇最省能的「主動推論」：員工會暗中抵制、找出 AI 的微小瑕疵並無限放大，證明「AI 果然沒用」。透過摧毀新系統，成功讓外在世界恢復成他們熟悉的舊模樣，消除預測誤差
消除對抗 (Eradicating the Adversarial Stance)：必須認知到員工的破壞行為並非「惡意」，而是生物系統「維持穩態 (Homeostasis)」的本能。高管必須從「懲罰破壞者」轉向「重構物理環境，使舊習慣失效」
en: Minimizing Free Energy: When reality violates the brain's predictions (generating Free Energy/Error), the brain has only two options to resolve it: 1) 'Update the internal model' (learn new skills—highly energy-intensive), or 2) 'Change reality to match the old model' (Active Inference).

Active Inference as Sabotage: Forcing veteran employees to learn complex AI systems (updating their internal models) is biologically painful. Thus, the brain chooses the path of least resistance ('Active Inference'): employees subconsciously sabotage the AI, amplifying minor glitches to prove 'the AI is useless.' By destroying the new system, they successfully force reality back into their familiar old model, eliminating the prediction error.

Eradicating the Adversarial Stance: We must recognize this sabotage is not 'malicious'; it is the biological instinct to maintain 'Homeostasis.' The C-Suite must pivot from 'punishing saboteurs' to 're-architecting the physical environment so old habits mathematically fail.'

speaker_notes.zh: 為什麼老員工總是能找出幾百個理由證明 AI 很難用，甚至暗中讓專案失敗？自由能原理裡的『主動推論 (Active Inference)』給出了最震撼的答案。當現實（AI 的介入）跟員工大腦的預測（舊的工作方式）不合時，大腦會極度焦慮。要消除這種焦慮，員工可以去『學 AI（更新大腦模型）』，但這太累了。大腦最喜歡的做法是『改變現實』！也就是透過破壞 AI 專案，讓 AI 滾出公司，這樣世界就又恢復成大腦熟悉的樣子了。各位，員工搞破壞不是因為他們壞，是因為大腦在趨吉避凶。我們如果只會用扣獎金來懲罰他們，就是在一頭撞向生物學的鐵牆。
speaker_notes.en: Why do veteran employees find hundreds of reasons to prove AI is useless, or secretly sabotage its deployment? The Free Energy Principle's concept of 'Active Inference' provides a shattering answer. When reality (AI deployment) violates the brain's predictive model (legacy workflows), the brain experiences massive anxiety. To resolve it, the employee can 'learn AI' (updating their brain model), but that burns massive energy. The brain's preferred, lazy route is to 'change reality'! By sabotaging the AI project and forcing it out of the company, reality is reverted to match their old, familiar predictive model. Gentlemen, they aren't sabotaging us out of malice; they are biologically minimizing prediction error. Punishing them with KPIs is smashing our heads against a biological brick wall.

slide_title.zh: 調解的認知科學：生成模型的動態對齊 (Mediation & Generative Models)
slide_title.en: The Cognitive Science of Mediation: Aligning Generative Models

zh: 衝突是生成模型的對撞 (Conflict is Clashing Generative Models)：在跨部門惡鬥中，業務部與法務部並非在爭奪對錯。他們是在保護各自大腦中用來預測世界運作的「生成模型 (Generative Models)」不被摧毀
說服的無效性 (The Futility of Persuasion)：試圖用邏輯或權力去「說服」對方，等同於直接攻擊對方的生成模型，這會引發大腦釋放皮質醇，進入「戰或逃 (Fight or Flight)」的極端發炎狀態
調解員作為誤差校準引擎 (The Mediator as the Calibration Engine)：高階調解員 (Mediator) 不說服任何人。調解員透過「戰略性同理心」，先完全符合對方的預測（建立心理安全感 / 零預測誤差）；接著，在極度安全的環境中，緩慢滴注「微小的預測誤差（新資訊）」，引導雙方大腦自發性地重新計算並對齊彼此的模型
en: Conflict is Clashing Generative Models: In cross-silo warfare, Sales and Legal are not fighting over 'right vs. wrong.' They are violently defending their respective 'Generative Models' (the fundamental algorithms their brains use to predict how the world works) from being annihilated by the other side.

The Futility of Persuasion: Attempting to 'persuade' an opponent using pure logic or executive authority is a direct assault on their Generative Model. This triggers a cortisol flood, forcing the brain into a hyper-inflamed 'Fight or Flight' state.

The Mediator as the Calibration Engine: Elite Mediators never persuade. Using 'Tactical Empathy,' the Mediator initially mirrors the opponent's predictions perfectly (creating psychological safety / zero prediction error). Then, within this hyper-secure environment, the Mediator slowly IV-drips 'micro prediction errors' (new data), guiding both brains to spontaneously recalculate and align their models.

speaker_notes.zh: 談判與調解的本質到底是什麼？在認知科學看來，衝突根本不是為了解決問題，衝突是兩個大腦的『生成模型』在互撞！業務部的大腦模型認為『速度等於生存』；法務部的大腦模型認為『合規才是生存』。你要他們互相妥協，等於要他們摧毀自己賴以生存的大腦模型，他們當然會跟你拼命！『高階調解員 (Mediator)』的作用，就是一台『預測誤差校準機』。我介入時，我先順著他們的話說（讓預測誤差降到零，解除防禦機制），然後我在對話中，精準地滴入一些微小的新資訊（微誤差）。在沒有生存威脅的情況下，他們的大腦會自發性地把對方的模型整合進來，完成無痛的共識對齊。
speaker_notes.en: What is the absolute biological essence of negotiation and mediation? Cognitive science proves conflict isn't about solving a problem; it is the violent collision of two brains' 'Generative Models'! Sales' brain predicts 'Velocity = Survival.' Legal's brain predicts 'Compliance = Survival.' Forcing them to compromise is demanding they destroy the very algorithms keeping them alive. They will fight to the death! The 'Executive Mediator' is a 'Prediction Error Calibration Engine.' When I intervene, I perfectly mirror their reality (driving prediction error to zero, disarming the biological defense). Then, in that secure void, I micro-dose 'tiny prediction errors' (new data). Without a threat to their survival, their brains spontaneously integrate the opponent's data, achieving a flawless, painless consensus.

slide_title.zh: AI 幻覺與馬可夫毯：保護組織的感知邊界 (Markov Blankets & AI Hallucinations)
slide_title.en: Markov Blankets & AI Hallucinations: Protecting Sensory Boundaries

zh: 馬可夫毯 (Markov Blanket)：自由能原理的關鍵概念。區隔系統內部狀態與外部環境的「數學邊界」。任何生命體（或企業）都必須依賴馬可夫毯（感測器與行動器）來過濾外界資訊，維持內部穩定
AI 幻覺即感知中毒 (AI Hallucinations as Sensory Poisoning)：當企業盲目接入未經驗證的 Generative AI 時，等於在企業的「馬可夫毯」上開了個大洞。AI 的偏見與幻覺會繞過邊界，直接毒害企業高管的大腦（內部生成模型），導致毀滅性的戰略誤判
ISO 42001 作為強化馬可夫毯 (ISO 42001 as the Reinforced Blanket)：AI 治理絕非阻礙。ISO 42001 的核心功能，是為企業的資料攝取端編織一張高密度的「馬可夫毯」。它嚴格過濾、清洗並驗證 AI 輸出的預測誤差，確保總部的戰略決策永遠基於高保真的數學現實
en: Markov Blanket: A critical concept in the Free Energy Principle. It is the mathematical boundary separating a system's internal states from the external environment. Every organism (or enterprise) relies on its Markov Blanket (sensors and active states) to filter external noise and maintain internal homeostasis.

AI Hallucinations as Sensory Poisoning: When an enterprise blindly integrates unvetted Generative AI, it rips a massive hole in its 'Markov Blanket.' The AI's inherent biases and hallucinations bypass the boundary, directly poisoning the C-Suite's 'internal generative models,' guaranteeing catastrophic strategic miscalculations.

ISO 42001 as the Reinforced Blanket: AI Governance is never a roadblock. The supreme function of ISO 42001 is weaving a high-density 'Markov Blanket' at the enterprise's data ingestion layer. It ruthlessly filters, sanitizes, and verifies AI-generated prediction errors, guaranteeing that HQ's strategic decisions are anchored purely in high-fidelity mathematical reality.

speaker_notes.zh: 卡爾·弗里斯頓提出了一個很美的概念叫『馬可夫毯』。這是一層把生命體跟外在混亂世界隔開的過濾網。沒有馬可夫毯，生命就會融化在混亂中。對企業來說，法務跟合規機制，就是我們的馬可夫毯！今天大家都在瘋 AI，把 LLM 直接接上公司的資料庫。這等於是把公司的馬可夫毯給撕爛了！AI 產生的那些幻覺和偏見，會像毒藥一樣直接進入 CEO 的大腦，干擾高層的戰略預測。我們推行 ISO 42001 (AI 治理)，就是在幫公司重新編織這層馬可夫毯，過濾掉 AI 的毒性，確保高管大腦裡的模型永遠準確。
speaker_notes.en: Karl Friston introduced a beautiful mathematical concept: the 'Markov Blanket.' It is the filtration boundary separating a living organism from external chaos. Without it, the organism dissolves into entropy. Corporately, Legal and Compliance mechanics ARE our Markov Blanket! Today, everyone is frantically plugging unfiltered LLMs directly into corporate data streams. This is ripping our Markov Blanket to shreds! The AI's hallucinations and toxic biases bypass our defenses, directly poisoning the CEO's brain (the internal generative model), guaranteeing fatal strategic miscalculations. Deploying ISO 42001 (AI Governance) is re-weaving this Markov Blanket, filtering out the AI's toxicity to ensure the C-Suite's predictive models remain flawlessly accurate.

slide_title.zh: 100 天認知重構與自由能最小化藍圖 (100-Day Free Energy Reboot)

zh: 第 1-30 天 (預測誤差審查與主動推論破除)：由 CHRO 主導全組織的「自由能體檢」。找出所有讓員工大腦產生「劇烈預測誤差」的突兀政策，停止用懲罰對抗員工暗中破壞的「主動推論」，改為平滑化學習曲線
第 31-100 天 (馬可夫毯上線與生成模型對齊)：將 ISO 42001 護欄硬編碼為企業 AI 系統的「馬可夫毯過濾網」；同時，高階調解團隊全面放棄「邏輯說服」，改採「預測誤差微調」技術，將死結中的跨部門衝突進行底層認知對齊
決策訴求 (Call to Action)：懇請董事會認知「人類是大腦的奴隸，而大腦是預測的機器」。授權我們啟動認知科學重構，不再與人性逆向肉搏，而是精準操控預測誤差，讓變革成為大腦最渴望的安全歸宿
en: Days 1-30 (Prediction Error Audit & Active Inference Mitigation): CHRO leads a corporate 'Free Energy Diagnostic.' Isolating all abrupt, jarring policies causing massive 'Prediction Errors' in the workforce. Ceasing punitive attacks on employee sabotage ('Active Inference') and instead smoothing the cognitive learning curve.

Days 31-100 (Markov Blanket Deployment & Generative Alignment): Hard-coding ISO 42001 guardrails as the enterprise AI system's 'Markov Blanket Filter.' Concurrently, the Mediation Team completely abandons 'logical persuasion,' deploying 'prediction-error micro-dosing' to execute deep-cognitive alignment on all cross-silo deadlocks.

Call to Action: Requesting the Board acknowledge that 'Humans are slaves to their brains, and brains are prediction machines.' Authorizing this Cognitive Science restructure. We will stop fighting human nature in hand-to-hand combat; instead, we will surgically manipulate prediction errors so that transformation becomes the brain's most desired, mathematically safe outcome.

speaker_notes.zh: 這是未來 100 天的企業認知重構藍圖。第一個月，HR 必須停止所有帶來巨大『預測誤差』的粗暴變革。員工搞破壞不是惡意，是大腦在保護自己。我們必須重新設計推廣方式，讓 AI 的導入符合員工大腦的預測慣性。接下來的兩個月，法務部要把 ISO 42001 這條『馬可夫毯』裝上去，保護公司不受 AI 幻覺的毒害。同時，調解員全面採用認知科學技術，透過精準滴注新資訊，無痛整合各部門的『生成模型』。懇請董事會授權，讓我們放棄對抗人性，用最高級的神經科學，讓改變自然發生。
speaker_notes.en: This is our 100-day Cognitive Science Reboot Blueprint. In Month 1, HR must halt all brute-force transformations causing massive 'Prediction Errors.' Employee sabotage isn't malice; it's the brain defending its existence. We must re-architect the rollout so AI integration smoothly aligns with the brain's predictive inertia. Over Months 2 and 3, Legal must deploy the ISO 42001 'Markov Blanket' to protect our strategic core from AI hallucinations. Simultaneously, Mediators deploy pure cognitive science—micro-dosing new data to painlessly fuse the clashing 'Generative Models' of hostile silos. I ask the Board to mandate this. Stop fighting human nature. Let us use flagship neuroscience to make transformation the brain's organic, desired outcome.

prompt_template.zh: 請以繁體中文製作一份大師級的『認知科學與自由能原理戰略』簡報。受眾為董事會、CEO 或 CHRO。內容必須將當代神經科學的終極大一統理論降維應用於變革管理、AI 治理與高階調解：1. 運用 SCQA 點出 HR 將變革抗拒誤診為『懶惰』的致命傷，導入大腦是『預測機器』的概念，2. 運用『主動推論 (Active Inference)』解釋員工暗中破壞 AI 系統，其實是大腦為了消除『預測誤差』而改變現實的生物本能，3. 將『高階調解 (Mediation)』重新定義為『生成模型 (Generative Models) 的對齊引擎』，說明為何邏輯說服無效，必須靠精準滴注預測誤差來無痛整合共識，4. 運用『馬可夫毯 (Markov Blanket)』概念，主張 ISO 42001 是過濾 AI 毒性幻覺、保護企業決策中樞的物理邊界，5. 結尾給出 100 天認知重構與自由能最小化藍圖。每張 Slide 不超過 3 個重點，語氣需極具神經生物學的冰冷精準、洞穿人性的學術高度，以及操控人類大腦底層代碼的駭客霸氣。
prompt_template.en: Please create a master-class 'Cognitive Science & Free Energy Principle Strategy' presentation in English. Audience: Board of Directors, CEO, or CHRO. Demonstrate the elite application of neuroscience's ultimate unified theory to change management, AI Governance, and Advanced Mediation: 1. Use SCQA to frame HR's fatal misdiagnosis of change resistance as 'laziness,' introducing the brain as a biological 'Prediction Machine.' 2. Deploy 'Active Inference' to explain employee sabotage of AI systems as a primal biological instinct to eliminate 'Prediction Error' by physically altering reality. 3. Redefine 'Advanced Mediation' as the 'Alignment Engine for Generative Models,' proving why logical persuasion fails and why Mediators must micro-dose prediction errors to seamlessly fuse consensus. 4. Utilize the 'Markov Blanket' concept to demand ISO 42001 as the absolute physical boundary filtering out toxic AI hallucinations and protecting the C-Suite's decision core. 5. Conclude with a 100-Day Cognitive Reboot & Free Energy Minimization Blueprint. Max 3 bullet points per slide. The tone must project the clinical precision of neurobiology, absolute clairvoyance into human nature, and the hacker-like dominance of rewriting the brain's base code.
